notes.title: Steam Page Is Now Live! But Where is the Beta?
notes.notes:
Hi Guys, thanks for being here! 

I’ve been working on this game, Eternal Hearts for about 1 year and a half now and am finally ready to share more about the game now that I’m closer to having something playable. This means putting it out to the world with a swanky new Steam Page!

So what's next you might ask?
[b]The beta! [/b] 

You can pre-register for the beta here:
[url=https://eternalheartsgame.com]https://eternalheartsgame.com[/url]

This means that you get to play the game faster than anyone else.

PS: I also put a FAQ and a "Where to reach/follow me" thing in the discussion board in case you still have questions about the game or want to contact me.

Cheers!
